LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
T-3101: full containment, 225,000 m3 working, Phase 2 (D-007). In-tank pumps hang in their pump columns with foot valves; every nozzle passes through the roof (drawn on the shell for clarity, D-021).
Minimum-flow returns FV-3111A..D: LNG-3021..3024 DN 150; FV-3112: LNG-3025 DN 100.

Column isolation HV-3151A..D, HV-3152 above the check valves; column vent / N2 purge BOG-3011..3015 DN 25 with HV-3161..3165 (blind-flanged; opened only after N2 displacement of the column into the tank, D-026.9).
CV-3121A..D, CV-3122: disc with a pressure-equalising hole, relieving the CV/HV spool to the pump column (thermal relief; vendor, D-021).
Thermal relief to T-3101 (roof nozzles), set 15.0 barg: PSV-3141 on LNG-3001 via LNG-3031, PSV-3142 on LNG-3002 via LNG-3032, DN 25.
PSV-3131A..C (0.29 barg) and vacuum relief PSV-3133A..C (-0.3 kPa(g)): N+1 each, inlet isolation HV-3134A..C / HV-3135A..C.
HV-3134A-C / HV-3135A-C locked open, mechanically interlocked so that N of the N+1 devices are always in service (D-026.11).
LZT-3102: see C&E I-301, I-302. LZT-3106: independent high-high, 1oo2 with LZT-3102 (C&E I-301). PZT-3112: see C&E I-303, I-304.
